items.title: Gucci Takes Demna's Cruise 2028 Show To Shanghai
items.summary: Malaysian business/lifestyle outlet reports Gucci will stage Demna's Cruise 2028 show in Shanghai on 17 May 2027, marking 30 years in China. Framed descriptively around Gucci's effort to rebuild ties with Chinese/Asian consumers after becoming "disconnected" from them; largely descriptive activation coverage of a brand-staged event, scored low magnitude.

items.title: Gucci Price Cuts Break Luxury's Biggest Taboo. Louis Vuitton Is Weighing It
items.summary: Forbes reports Gucci quietly cut prices on handbags, footwear and ready-to-wear (e.g. Padlock bag down ~30% in France) as permanent repricing, not seasonal markdowns, framed as a sign of sustained demand weakness after 13 straight quarters of declining sales; Kering calls them 'targeted corrections' on overpriced items. Independent critical-angle business analysis, directly relevant to Gucci's broader Asia-Pacific retail struggles that include SEA markets.

items.title: Gucci reportedly cuts prices as turnaround pressure builds
items.summary: Trade outlet corroborates the Gucci price-cut story (Mercato tote down 20-25%, sneakers from EUR800 to EUR560-595), framing it as a desperation move amid 6% comparable sales decline in Q3, weak China/Japan foot traffic, and competitive pressure from Burberry; flags risk of alienating full-price buyers and denting brand exclusivity. Neutral-to-critical independent trade analysis.

items.title: Gucci cuts prices on select merchandise by up to 30% after 13 straight quarters of declining sales
items.summary: Widely syndicated X post summarizing the Gucci price-cut story, contrasting Gucci's move with Louis Vuitton's reluctance to follow; organic SNS commentary circulating the turnaround-pressure narrative rather than brand-issued content. Exact like/retweet counts not retrievable via public view; recorded null per no-fabrication rule.

items.title: BTS Jin as Gucci's global ambassador: his best looks so far
items.summary: Tatler Asia (SEA-wide reach incl. Singapore, Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Philippines editions) runs a curated retrospective of BTS Jin's Gucci campaign and red-carpet looks, noting one jacket "reportedly sold out across Europe in under 24 hours." Structurally a brand-ambassador amplification piece dressed as style editorial; descriptive praise without independent verdict beyond the sold-out claim, so capped as activation coverage.

items.title: Gulf Kanawut's brand collaborations in 2026: Gucci, Onitsuka Tiger, Sulwhasoo and more
items.summary: Tatler Asia profile of Thai actor Gulf Kanawut's 2026 brand slate lists his Gucci ambassadorship among several deals (Onitsuka Tiger, Sulwhasoo), descriptive and promotional in nature with no independent evaluative verdict on Gucci specifically; indicates continued SEA-celebrity-ambassador reliance in the region's Gucci marketing mix.

items.title: Antara Underground dan Glamor, Strategi Demna Selamatkan Gucci
items.summary: Major Indonesian daily (Detik/Wolipop) analyzes Demna's 'underground meets glamour' creative strategy as an attempt to rescue/turn around Gucci, framing it within the brand's ongoing sales struggle rather than pure celebration; a mixed piece balancing design commentary with turnaround stakes, read by Indonesia's mainstream fashion audience.

items.title: Warehouses full of fake Gucci, Dior, Hermes goods busted in Vietnam crackdown
items.summary: VnExpress International (Vietnam's largest English-language outlet) reports authorities raided warehouses stocked with counterfeit Gucci, Dior and Hermes merchandise, part of a continuing crackdown on fake-goods networks; factual/neutral reporting but relevant reputational-proximity signal (counterfeit saturation undermining brand exclusivity perception in Vietnam).

items.title: Gucci La Famiglia: Khoi dau ky nguyen moi duoi ban tay Demna
items.summary: Vietnamese edition of Elle covers Gucci's La Famiglia collection as the opening chapter of Demna's new era, descriptive collection write-up (silhouettes, campaign concept) without independent critical verdict; standard activation coverage reaching Vietnam's fashion-reader base.

items.title: Gucci Thailand brand Facebook page activity
items.summary: Checked Gucci's official Thailand Facebook presence (Priority-A SNS source per buzz registry) as part of mandatory SNS coverage; page shows ongoing brand-owned product/campaign posts consistent with routine activation content. No independent public reaction thread found attached beyond standard brand posting; recorded as brand-owned baseline check, not counted as organic buzz.

items.source: Investing.com (Kering Q3 earnings coverage, syndicated regionally)
items.title: Earnings call transcript: Kering Q3 2026 shares sink as Gucci recovery lags
items.summary: Kering Q3 2026 earnings call transcript shows Gucci retail sales down 9% with Asia-Pacific overall down 8%, weak foot traffic cited in mainland China and Japan; South Korea cited as a bright spot but Southeast Asia not singled out as strong. Widely syndicated across Asian financial news feeds including SEA-facing finance portals; independent, critical-leaning earnings coverage.

items.title: Gucci news tag feed - FashionNetwork Vietnam
items.summary: FashionNetwork's Vietnamese edition news tag aggregates recent Gucci wire coverage (price cuts, Shanghai Cruise 2028 announcement, Kering earnings) for Vietnam's trade/fashion-industry readers; checked as a regional trade aggregator feed rather than a single story, confirming the price-cut and Shanghai stories are circulating in SEA-local trade press, not just global media.

collection_notes: Critical-angle searches surfaced genuine, fresh (2026-11-13 to 2026-11-18) organic/independent negative-to-mixed coverage: the Gucci price-cut/turnaround story (Forbes, TheIndustry.fashion, X/SNS reaction) and the Kering Q3 earnings transcript showing APAC retail sales down 8-9%. Pantip, Kaskus, Lowyat Forum, HardwareZone, and Webtretho were checked (site-scoped searches in en/th/id/vi) but yielded no items within the 14-day freshness window - results were either generic product/counterfeit-authentication threads or stale (a Thai 'Granny dress' viral story from 2020 and a HardwareZone 'reputation fallen' thread from January 2026 were found but excluded as too old per policy). Indonesia's Mahalini/Rizky Febian pro-Israel boycott backlash is a real recurring SEA sentiment theme but the available coverage dates to 2024, so it was excluded rather than padded in; no fresh boycott-angle story surfaced in Indonesia this cycle. Pool skews toward ambassador/activation coverage (Jin, Gulf Kanawut, La Famiglia) balanced against turnaround/price-cut critical coverage; no SEA-specific organic community backlash item met the freshness bar today, which the sentiment-classifier and index-interpreter should note as a channel-mix limitation.
